text: Not nearly as soft as others I own. Sorry to say this simply is not as soft as other fleece I own. It is simply ok. It does have nicely sewn edges and will due. I have much softer fleece from other stores.

product_metadata.title: Utopia Bedding Fleece Blanket Full Size White Lightweight Fuzzy Soft Anti-Static Microfiber Bed Blanket (90x84 Inches)
features: SUPER SOFT AND LIGHTWEIGHT- Enjoy the warmth and comfort with our cozy flannel fleece blanket woven from 250 GSM microfiber filling that encapsulates breathability and style
ELEGANTLY DESIGNED – Double-sided brushed fabric with a 1-inch hem having double-needled stitching makes the blanket highly durable to ensure years of usage. Perfect for snuggling in the bed or couch

PAIR UP WITH HOME DÉCOR - Spice up your home décor with this super soft flannel fleece blanket. The available colors give you enough options to pair it up with your couch, bedsheet, rug, or curtains while giving a luxurious look to your home

ALL-ROUND USABILITY – The skin-friendly comfy fleece blanket provides an all-season utility. Drape it over the couch, make it a bedspread, or hold it over your shoulders while camping or near the bonfire
CARE GUIDE – Retain the longevity of this flannel fleece blanket through machine wash with cold water and tumble dry with low heat. No shrinkage even after multiple wash cycles
